summary: Iter75 Signature→R2 migration regression — backend pytest 8 passed / 3 skipped, frontend Playwright assertions on AdminSignatureMigrationPanel all passed. Backend: /api/admin/signatures/status returns the documented shape with grand_total.cloud=14 and base64=0 (idempotent migration confirmed); dry-run + commit endpoints behave per spec; commit is idempotent (migrated=0, failed=0 on re-run); X-Admin-Token gating enforced (401/403 on missing/invalid). Frontend: panel mounts below CloudArchivesPanel with all 6 required testids, refresh button loads status and populates the 4 stat boxes (10 records w/ sigs, 14 cloud, 0 base64, 0 bytes recoverable), per-collection table renders daily_reports/inspections/incidents rows, Migrate Now + Dry Run are correctly disabled when base64=0, and the 'All signatures live in R2 — nothing left to migrate.' confirmation badge is present (CSS uppercase). R2 health badge reads 'Cloudflare R2 connected and ready'. Two skipped backend cases were the padding-repair unit test (R2 not configured inside the pytest runner) and the PDF-render-with-photo-ref test (the /api/daily-reports list endpoint omits signature fields so we can't filter for photo:// records, but main agent already verified PDF render manually). One critical build-breaker was found and fixed by the testing agent: duplicate 'import { resolvePhotoSrc }' in ViewMeeting.jsx and FieldLeadershipView.jsx caused webpack/ESLint parsing errors that blocked the entire frontend build — fix applied (removed the second duplicate import in each file). Main agent should review this fix.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate `import { resolvePhotoSrc } from "@/lib/photoSrc"` declared twice — caused 'Identifier resolvePhotoSrc has already been declared' parse error that broke the whole frontend webpack build. Testing agent fixed by removing the second occurrence in both files (FieldLeadershipView.jsx line 22, ViewMeeting.jsx line 18). Main agent should sanity-check.

action_items: Review the two duplicate-import fixes the testing agent applied in /app/frontend/src/pages/ViewMeeting.jsx and /app/frontend/src/pages/FieldLeadershipView.jsx (each had `import { resolvePhotoSrc }` twice → kept only the first import). This was a real build-blocker — webpack/ESLint were emitting parse errors before the fix.

Optional: when packing the daily-reports / inspections list endpoint response, the prepared_by_signature / inspector_signature fields are stripped → testers can't easily target a photo:// record from list-only output. The detail endpoint also returns empty signature. If this is intentional payload-shrinking (likely is), document it; otherwise expose at least the signature TYPE (photo://… or empty) for verification tooling.
critical_code_review_comments: The duplicate `resolvePhotoSrc` import bug shows up in BOTH files that were edited in this iter — suggests the main agent's edit script appended an import without checking if one already existed. Worth adding a quick `grep -c 'resolvePhotoSrc' file` lint to the iter75 changelist or using `eslint --rule no-duplicate-imports:error` as a pre-commit guard.

signature_migration.py is clean (318 lines, focused). Atomicity: it collects all successful R2 uploads first, then issues a single $set update per record (good). Failure mode: if 5 of 10 sigs in one record upload OK and the 6th fails, the 5 successful uploads still get committed (the R2 objects exist; only their DB references get persisted because the loop continues on failure and the $set runs for the 5 succeeded fields). This is desirable for resumability but worth a comment in the docstring.

The status endpoint scans every doc in 11 collections on every call (no caching). With 54 daily_reports + 7 inspections + 4 incidents today that's fine, but at 10k+ docs this becomes a 1-2s call. Acceptable for an admin-only tool — flagging for future scale.

photo_storage.upload_data_url padding repair is correct (pad to multiple of 4 with '='). Verified with a stripped-padding PNG in the test (locally skipped because R2 creds aren't propagated to the pytest runner; main agent's preview run already exercised this against real records).
seed_data_creation: None — preview DB already had 14 migrated sigs from main agent's earlier run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter75 migration is fully migrated in preview (14 cloud / 0 base64). The AdminSignatureMigrationPanel correctly disables both action buttons in this state and shows the green 'All signatures live in R2' confirmation. To exercise the dry-run/commit happy paths against base64 data again, you'd need to either roll back the migration or seed fresh base64 records. The build-breaker duplicate-import bug in ViewMeeting.jsx and FieldLeadershipView.jsx has been fixed by this run.
rca of the issue: Duplicate `import { resolvePhotoSrc } from "@/lib/photoSrc"` in ViewMeeting.jsx (lines 11 and 18) and FieldLeadershipView.jsx (lines 16 and 22) caused webpack/ESLint to emit `Parsing error: Identifier 'resolvePhotoSrc' has already been declared.` and the frontend bundle failed to compile cleanly. Root cause: iter75's automated edit added a new `import { resolvePhotoSrc }` to each file without first checking whether the import already existed (both files already imported it earlier in their import block). Reproduction (pre-fix): `tail /var/log/supervisor/frontend.out.log` → 'webpack compiled with 3 errors'. Mitigation (applied): removed the duplicate import in both files; webpack now compiles cleanly and the View pages load.
